title: S&P 500 Churns After $3.7 Trillion Rally to Record: Markets Wrap

title: Iran Says Agreement Reached With Oman on Hormuz Shipping
summary: Iran said it reached an agreement with Oman on a proposed route for shipping through the Strait of Hormuz, a potential step toward a reopening of the critical waterway for energy supplies. Both sides have been talking for days about how to manage the Strait. A joint statement is being reviewed. Bloomberg's Jeff Mason has the latest from the White House on "Balance of Power." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Comex Copper Climbs to Record High on Tariff Speculation

title: EU Audit Offers Brazil’s Poultry Exports a Path Around Ban
summary: The European Union will carry out an audit in Brazil at the end of August that could allow the country’s poultry exports to avoid a ban due to take effect on Sept. 3.

title: Starboard Value CEO Jeff Smith on New Shake Shack Stake

title: Stocks Erase Gains Amid Profit Taking, Rate Hike Fears Mount

title: Barclays, HSBC Say Inflation-Protected Bonds Appeal
summary: Barclays Plc and HSBC Holdings Plc say concern the Federal Reserve is dragging its feet on inflation is giving investors another reason to buy bonds that offer protection from accelerating price growth.

title: US Diesel Exports Surge to Record as World Grasps for Supply
summary: The US shipped a record amount of distillate fuel overseas last week as domestic stockpiles fell again, the latest sign that the global scramble for diesel is increasingly draining US supplies.

title: Starboard Value Has Taken a Position in Shake Shack, CEO Smith Says

title: Disney’s Streaming and Parks Drive Third-Quarter Profits
summary: Walt Disney's profit beat Wall Street estimates in the company’s fiscal third quarter, driven by soaring income from its entertainment division and the resilience of its theme parks in California and Florida. Bloomberg's Geetha Ranganathan joins Bloomberg Intelligence to discuss Disney as well as Paramount Skydance's earnings. (Source: Bloomberg)
